Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we can kick off the security review and confirm the buying path.

Recap (30-min discovery):
- Primary use case: KiteCorp will use Redwood’s hosted API to power a private-agent assistant for internal operations (ticket triage + policy lookup).
- Expected query volume: ~350k tokens/day in steady state; spike testing expected during pilot.
- Models: starting with a smaller open LLM (optimized for latency); potential to move to higher-capacity variant after pilot.
- Data flow: app -> Redwood hosted inference (request metadata + user query). No customer data is stored long-term unless explicitly configured.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please fill the attached security intake worksheet (redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx) with your systems in scope and return by EOD Friday. This helps us confirm whether we need Private deployment or Hosted with additional controls.
2) Confirm procurement path and approximate timeline (who is the procurement owner, what sign-off approvals are required).
3) Share any existing network diagrams (we're happy to redact) and call out if the assistant will be handling tokenized PII or PHI.

Laura (security solutions) and Ben (AE) are CC'd — Laura will own the technical review once you return the questionnaire. If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min security kickoff next week.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx

Thanks — quick technical plan and pilot gating checklist below. I included Alex on this note so KiteCorp sees proposed items and can confirm.

Short answer: Hosted can work for pilot with the controls below; Private deployment not required unless KiteCorp insists on no third-party co-tenancy or needs a dedicated VPC.

Pilot gating checklist (recommended):
- SOC 2 Type II snapshot (attached): redwood-soc2-snapshot.pdf
- IP allowlist for pilot application endpoints (we will provide ephemeral ranges)
- Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and encryption at rest for any retained logs
- Data retention window: default 30 days (can be configured to 0 days for pilot if requested)
- Prompt/data handling: provide a sanitized sample prompt set for QA — we can run a small eval to check outputs
- Monitoring/tracing: enable request-level tracing for the pilot to debug misrouted queries
- PII handling: recommend masking employee IDs before sending; if not feasible, we can enable additional logging controls and shorter retention window

Next steps / owners:
- Laura: run questionnaire through technical intake and return any follow-ups to Alex by EOD Thu.
- Ben: prepare pilot SOW and indicative pricing for 3-month pilot and share a draft with procurement@kitecorp.com by Mon, May 3.
- Alex / Procurement: confirm whether they want 0-day retention for pilot or are comfortable with 30 days.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-snapshot.pdf

If KiteCorp is comfortable with the checklist above we can schedule the kickoff call on Tue 5/4 — suggest 30 min to align network allowlist and SAML/Okta settings.

Thanks,
